name: The Lobby
description: See every agent in every worktree in one live view: pixel people in a room per project, who needs you or seems stuck, org charts of who started whom, and context and tokens per agent. Everything is read on your machine.

cover.alt: The Lobby: the pixel title and orca mascot, a tagline, and two project rooms with Need you!, Stuck? and Failed speech bubbles

screenshots.caption: Every agent, every worktree, one glance

screenshots.caption: Know who needs you
